subject: general
question: The first cross-country pipeline in Asia connected the Naharkatiya oilfield in Assam to which refinery?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barauni Refinery**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Location:** The pipeline connects Assam, known for its vast oil reserves, to Bihar, where the refinery processes the crude oil.
 
• **Significance:** This pipeline was crucial for ensuring efficient transportation of crude oil over long distances, reducing reliance on road and rail transport, which were less economical and time-consuming.
 
• **Barauni Refinery:** Located in Bihar, it is one of the oldest refineries in India. This refinery processes crude oil to produce petroleum products, supporting industrial and domestic energy needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Naharkatiya Oilfield:** The oilfield is operated by **Oil India Limited (OIL)**, which is a major player in India's petroleum industry.
 
• **Barauni Refinery:** It is operated by **Indian Oil Corporation (IOC)**, one of India's largest oil companies.
 
 
• Pipeline transportation is considered one of the most efficient methods for transporting crude oil and petroleum products over long distances.
 
• Such pipelines ensure reduced transportation costs, minimized environmental risks, and improved efficiency in energy distribution.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Major Refineries in India:**

 
 
• **Haldia Refinery:** Situated in West Bengal, it is operated by Indian Oil Corporation and was established in **1975**.
 
• **India's growing energy demand** has led to significant investments in refinery capacity and pipeline networks.
 
• The government has launched initiatives like **Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga Project** to expand pipeline infrastructure across the country.
